company.name: Pelica (YC X25)
company.shortDescription: Pelica is building healthcare's AI operating system
company.description: Pelica Health is the operating system for value-based care. Pelica unifies claims, EHR, pharmacy, lab, and ADT data into one live record per member and puts an AI copilot next to every team that depends on it, across risk adjustment, Quality and Stars, pharmacy and Part D, provider network, and care management. Founded by former Google and YouTube AI leaders and backed by Y Combinator. HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2 Type II.

productsAndServices.description: An AI system that understands a software team's architecture and conventions to assist in designing and building enterprise-scale systems.
